scientific_scope_status: For every finite stochastic channel K with classical transmitted input and arbitrary finite quantum reference, the complete equal-reference Umegaki contraction coefficient, conditional Umegaki contraction coefficient, and complete SLD metric coefficient coincide. This is a classical transmitted-channel theorem. It does not assert complete-Umegaki equality for arbitrary quantum channels or identify these coefficients with ordinary single-ensemble mutual-information contraction.
